question: What is the penalty for not registering a sale deed under Section 83 of the Registration Act?
answer_shown_to_user:

[L1] Registration Act, 1908, Section 83, p.22: "83. [L3] Registration Act, 1908, Section 50, p.15: "50. Certain registered documents relating to land to take effect against unregistered documents.—(1) Every document of the kinds mentioned in clauses (a), (b), (c) and (d) of section 17, sub-section (1), and clauses (a) and (b) of section 18, shall, if duly registered, take effect as regards the property comprised therein, against every ..."
original_model_response: According to [L1], a prosecution for any offence under the Registration Act coming to the knowledge of a registering officer may be commenced by or with the permission of the Inspector-General, the Registrar, or the Sub-Registrar, in whose territories, district, or sub-district the offence has been committed. However, [L1] does not specify the exact penalty for not registering a sale deed. It only states that such a prosecution may be commenced.
